EPD-IES-0005222:003.name: Tagene crushed-granite rock fines 0/2 mm (product group 3)
notes: EPD revision 2024-11-18, valid until 2026-12-15; NCC Industry Nordic AB, Tagene quarry, Gothenburg, Sweden.
Table 5, product group 3 (including Stenmjöl 0/2): A1-A3 GWP-GHG is 2.0 kg CO2 eq. per 1000 kg product, normalized to 0.002 kg CO2e/kg.
A4 and A5 are not declared in the EPD. Null placeholders remain missing; no transport, installation or waste factors are inferred.
The EPD method is retained as published and is not relabelled as Boverket GWP-GHG AR4. Only the carbon reference changes; the sand's thermal properties are retained.
EPD-IES-0005222:003.proxy_for: Retained dry sand fill; crushed-granite aggregate proxy, not a verified historic product match
